MyRO v1.7.0
Apply to the released 1.6.3 ISO using Apply-Update.cmd. Select your existing 1.6.3 game ISO; the updater verifies it, keeps a backup and builds MyRO-Current.iso. Upload/mount the rebuilt game using your usual method. This is an original-Xbox build, also usable in xemu. Game saves are not edited by the updater.

Included completed work:
- Quest window and per-character quest tracking, using original quest text and available objective counters. The window replaces Status at the left; Status moves to the middle. The closed-window tracker hides while the quest window is open.
- Additional original solo quest, skill-quest, crafting, city, museum, information and service NPCs. Includes authentic First Aid, Shrink quest access, Hugel missing-person room, original hair services and airport staff.
- Original single/dual Hugel monster races and ticket/medal conversations, the airship typing challenge, and Gonryun's original strength-test/500z solo monster arena. Gonryun offers all65 source monsters with its original3minute limit.
- All MVP maximum HP reduced to20% and outgoing damage to50%; normal monsters, boss rewards and respawn rules retained.
- Guardian sprite artwork preserved from1.6.3, with attack cadence/animation synchronization adjustments and directional arrow artwork for Bow Guardians. Original3D mode remains available.
- Storm Gust freeze/knockback and overlapping-hit handling; Lord of Vermillion waves/hit interruption and status corrections. Shared freeze/stun resistance fixes and corrected SP costs for affected skills.
- Developer Rates page with globally saved EXP/drop multipliers. Normal cards/equipment default2x; EXP retains level-based scaling and drops stay flat.
- Fixed zoom choices: Closest48, Furthest16, Starting36. Temporary Display submenu removed; Always Show Quests is in Video. Original portals remain enabled.
- Narrower Basic Info, compass clearance/decoration and message-description spacing fixes. Expanded/Super Novice facing/walk-cadence adjustments.
- Bounded enemy frame caches reduce repeated frame-file reads without changing artwork. Actual console FPS gains still require play testing.

Deferred to1.7.1:
- Remaining solo NPC coverage/branch review and any dependent unfinished services.
- NPC portrait/cutin, emotion and special-effect rendering that is not yet complete.
- Further all-skill behavior/animation review beyond the completed corrections.
- Proposed off-screen monster activation/sleep policy and further performance work.
- Story campaign/companions remain a separate future project; party/guild/WoE/online services remain excluded.

Validation: native Xbox compilation; exact rebuilt-ISO/file hashes and updater safety tests; targeted quest/service/arena/race, combat, preferences, sprite/data and journal regressions. These are targeted checks, not certification of every original quest branch. New version has not been physically tested on an Xbox by the developer; player hardware testing remains necessary.

MyRO v1.7.1 - RAM and traversal fix

Apply to the released1.7.0 ISO with Apply-Update.cmd. The usual updater verifies your original, retains its backup and builds MyRO-Current.iso. Transfer/mount the rebuilt game as usual. Character saves are not modified by this updater.

RAM and loading:
- Terrain/scenery textures and geometry now decompress directly into their final graphics buffers with fixed96KiB IO workspace. Large complete temporary copies are removed. Exact existing pixels, coordinates, UVs and formats are preserved; Brasilis's existing pavement filter is retained.
- Large scenery textures are reserved before smaller map allocations, reducing pressure on contiguous graphics memory. Empty scenery no longer allocates an unused atlas.
- Original50 monster types now stream exact animation frames rather than retaining complete decompressed animations. Their original colors, crop pixels, anchors, sequences and timings are preserved. This extends streaming to older monsters such as Giant Whisper and Wild Rose; newer monsters already streamed.
- Actor textures allocate when drawn rather than eagerly reserving up to34full64KiB buffers per map.
- Field and targeting-ring opacity variants share a bounded1MiB graphics cache. Images are rebuilt as needed with unchanged pixels. This replaces growth across many texture/opacity combinations during play.
- Idle NPC pose/art caches and unpinned script programs are reclaimed during area/class changes. Running script call frames remain pinned.
- Monster frame caches reduce their budgets under low available RAM. These changes apply globally, not specifically to Thor3.

Traversal:
- Audited494maps with actual collision and movement code. Added8,596source-verified walkable stair/height transitions across128maps, retaining241previous fixes (8,837total).
- Pyramid04's1,632identified false height rejections are resolved, including the reported ring area. Both cells must be source-walkable and source/rendered floor heights must agree for these additions.
- Original blocked cells and solid-object/footprint checks are retained. Unverified discrepancies remain blocked for further investigation; automated checks cannot establish that every visually apparent passage is intended to be walkable.

Validation:
- Native original-Xbox executable/ISO build.
- All494maps/1,976streamed sections compared byte-for-byte with existing terrain, scenery, geometry and metadata; CRC/short-read and memory-sanitizer checks.
- All50original monster species/2,558frames compared with accepted images and animation data; memory-sanitizer checks.
- Full494map traversal comparison,8,837bidirectional verified seams and millions of blocked-source-cell checks.
- Bounded effects cache/pinned-script cache and targeted combat, quest, job-route, data and preference regressions.
- Packaged updater reconstruction, file hashes, backup/receipt, repeat-run and damaged-input rejection.

These checks do not measure actual console free RAM/FPS. Please test Lighthalzen and Glast Heim Knight01, including repeated travel and casting, on your Xbox. The fixes should reduce pressure, but map-specific remaining problems require those hardware results.

Other NPC implementation and portrait work are parked. The requested smaller NPC text windows/font cleanup are queued after this stability fix and are not mixed into this patch.

MyRO v1.7.2
Apply to the released 1.7.1 ISO with Apply-Update.cmd. The updater verifies the starting image, keeps a backup, and reconstructs MyRO-Current.iso. Upload or mount the rebuilt image using your usual method. This is an original-Xbox build, also usable in xemu. The updater does not edit game saves.

Included:
- Smaller NPC dialogue windows sized to their text; long pages retain scrolling. Answer lists wrap and stay clear of the dialogue panel.
- Clear native 11px dialogue glyphs and spacing matched to Basic Info, including readable item/skill descriptions. Other font/atlas regions are unchanged.
- 258original dialogue illustrations, including original quest/card pictures and hairstyle previews. A single optional portrait texture is loaded when requested and released afterward; low-memory situations skip the illustration safely.
- Original emote animations with the correct emotion/action mapping; original SPR/ACT and STR NPC effects streamed as individual frames. Source placement and animation timing are retained in the bounded playback system.
- 66additional original effect sound cues, sharing the existing 2 MiB streamed audio cache. Existing NPC audio and original-Xbox AC97 output remain intact.
- Correct player, current-NPC and named-NPC targets, including the older named-emote syntax used by beauticians and quest NPCs.
- Ordinary-monster OnTouchNPC events, mobattached and unitemote support with monster-lifetime checks. Includes Maheo's original reaction to nearby creatures.
- The effect GPU pool now allocates slots only when drawn and releases them on map/class changes, removing its previous 2.5 MiB idle reservation. All 1.7.1 map-streaming, sprite-cache and traversal fixes are retained.

Validation: native Xbox compilation; dialogue layout/font checks; all packed portrait/effect frame bounds and CRCs; actual effect upload/playback/cache tests; streamed sound-cache tests; Maheo's introduction, missing-item and complete reward/encounter branches; First Aid, skill/crafting/city/service/appearance/Kafra/journal/program-cache regressions; exact updater reconstruction and file hashes.

Limits: these are targeted checks, not proof of every original quest branch or console performance. Some client-only procedural cosmetic effects still require dedicated renderers; source script handling and quest state do not depend on their display. Existing party, guild, WoE, online-economy and other unsupported system exclusions remain. This update does not claim all future NPC systems or the full skill audit are complete. Please test on the Xbox, especially previously tight-memory maps.

MYRO v1.9.3 — FOUR-CHAPTER STORY PREVIEW

Extract the whole ZIP, run Apply-Update.cmd and select your released 1.9.0,
1.9.1 or 1.9.2 ISO. The updater creates MyRO-Current.iso. Use your usual
Xbox transfer or xemu process. Folder installs need ALL files from the new
image, including campaign.bin, chapter1.bin and storyportraits.bin.
Saves and settings use the normal E:\MyROOffline folder.

STORY AND COMPANIONS
Start a fresh Novice without Developer Mode to play the campaign. Finish the
Training Grounds; the journal then guides you to the driver south of Prontera.
The preview covers four chapters: Prontera, Payon/Alberta, Geffen/Izlude,
and Morroc/Pyramids. It stops explicitly after Chapter 4. Story recruitment
introduces Roan, Yuufa, Judia, Maya, Brann, Takius, Pip and Iruga. Recruitment
can be postponed where offered. Up to three companions travel with you.
Open Pause > Game > Companions for the roster, settings and controller guide.
Only active, living nearby companions earn EXP; they have independent base
and job levels, personality builds and story-gated job promotions. Reserve
members do not gain EXP. Maya's Potion Pitcher consumes your Red Potions;
her skill use starts OFF so you can choose whether to spend supplies.

Developer Mode is a testing sandbox: the three humorous confirmation prompts
convert a campaign character out of normal story progression. Keep your normal
story character separate from your morphing developer test character.

UI AND COMBAT
Compact gold Main/silver Side quest groups; concise larger objectives, live
collection/kill counters and fixed-position completion/failure markers.
Use Y in the journal for full quest text, A to track or untrack.
Larger damage and Miss art; critical burst fits its centered number.
Centered larger equipment preview, compact icon/name fields and bold headers.
Hotbar quantity backing; bold current HP/SP; status equals column.
Hold X to add stats repeatedly. Developer items now have subtype menus/icons.
Item hover descriptions no longer print raw metadata or split into extra boxes.
Bash now plays the original cast/impact cues and effects, with actual damage
and numbers delayed to the attack's impact. No additional assets required.

VALIDATION
Native nxdk Xbox build and host sanitizer checks, actual packed map placement
renders, companion combat/growth/save tests and shipped PowerShell updater
verification. Original Xbox gameplay, audio and CRT acceptance remain for
hands-on testing; no hardware performance guarantee is implied.

Version 2.0.0 remains reserved for the complete campaign. The guild-base
upgrade/arcade proposal is not included in this preview.

# Test43: Payon expedition and base level99 — awaiting requested source assets

User authorizes Payon, its overland connecting route and Payon Dungeon with all
source-defined enemies BEFORE second jobs. Also explicitly requests base cap99.
Base is frozen Test42; no new gameplay release built during this request turn.
Do not modify/rebuild42. This supersedes previous43/next-batch plans.

Required input / prepared deliverable
/workspace/myro/asset-request43/Payon-Expansion/Collect-Payon-Assets.cmd
Read-only Windows collector uses the known client root (client picker fallback)
and automatically finds the server gameplay root near it and under MyRO. No
server-folder picker. Validates npc/pre-re/{warps,mobs} and db/pre-re/mob_db.conf. Uses real source warp
graph, shortest connected overland route from existing7 maps to Payon, then
Archer Village/pay_arche and pay_dun00..04. No guessed portal coordinates.
Only selected map GAT/GND/RSW + recursively referenced terrain/model textures and
RSM; selected spawn lines and monster DB blocks/SPR/ACT; referenced monster sounds;
selected music if indexed; exact exp_group_db.conf/job_db.conf for level99.
Optional three Merchant BMP icons included if found. Do not recollect broad
asset trees, server configs/accounts or unrelated NPC scripts. GRF precedence
and loose overrides follow existing Reader. Payload ≤24MiB per volume, each ZIP
verified<32MiB,512MiB total raw cap. Send ALL matching Desktop volumes.
Assets.csv per-part hashes, common Report.json maps/routes/monsterIDs/missing/errors
and Route.txt. Complete=false/exit2 for missing required data. Source/license and
fixture tests included. No client writes, install/admin/network/autoupload.
Fixture tests pass real PowerShell wrapper + C#; live Windows archive/GUI unrun.
Reference source job_db full HP/SP arrays already exist; full EXP table missing.

Pending fixes (NOT YET IMPLEMENTED; combine with map expansion after assets)
- Cart final13 world units (corrects previously accepted15).
- Outgoing hit sound fixed20ms; user tested attacks, Double Attack and bolts.
  Remove sound slider; retain multi-hit spacing/non-hit sound behavior.
- Replace its Player row with successful-cast minimum DIAMETER slider, numbered
  world units, proposed16..56 step2/default32. Diameter, not radius. Await user's
  preferred size after release. No final value claimed as authentic.
- Successful white/red circle: keep.6s shrink, slightly slower rotation (proposed
 20% slower), hold final size1.5s (was1s), total2.1s. Adjust preview/event lifetime.
- Select must NOT freeze simulation. Only START explicitly pauses. Continue AI,
  damage/DoTs/regen/cast/effect/sound timers under Select and other non-Start
  menus. Route UI input separately; no unintended movement/skill activations
  from navigation. Preserve active auto-attack when merely opening Select;
  assignment cancellation remains deliberate. Handle player KO/cast finish while
  editing windows. Existing map/camera/controls preserved. Test actual tick path,
  not just paused flag:42 excludes ui.active/menuInput/shop/job from combat_tick.
- Cast blue ticks: screenshot shows wide unticked end zones after prior fix.
  Need equal complete end segments and uniform1px separators spanning full width.
  Keep real cast timing; no invisible margins. Consider near48px dynamically
  sized bar with integer cells rather than forcing46px and big leftover ends.
  Verify whole bar from first fill through completion for all durations/ranks.
- Blue AIMING ring must be continuous raised triangular cross-section: join
  inner bases, outer bases AND apex ridge around whole circumference. Remove
  individual pyramid geometry and simple connecting flat band; a single annular
  peaked strip gives the shape user described (pyramid traced around a circle).
  Retain shimmer; interior +5 percentage points opacity, slightly toward cyan.
  Proposed existing fill alpha12/20/28 ->25/33/41 out of255, color101/234/250.
  Preserve square numerical hit area; prototype geometry clearly identified.
- Thunder Storm currently functional but user dislikes visual fidelity. Keep
  this recorded as unfinished original-effect work, do not call it authentic or
  silently revert the giant LoV-like composite. Don't block exploration on it.
- All other42 checklist items accepted, including practice AI/FireWall, menu
  order/highlights, cart/save fix, glow/callout, target markers and hotbars.
  Do not ask user to repeat exhaustive accepted spell testing.

Expansion scope / implementation constraints
- Append new map IDs; preserve existing0..6. Derive gates/spawns from returned
  source metadata, include normal and boss_monster species, not a handpicked
  substitute selection. Include all five classic Payon Dungeon floors. Interiors
  outside connecting route are not implied by Payon town. Existing NPC art can
  support useful town services; do not collect all NPC families speculatively.
- All source enemy TYPES/spawns collected; advanced original monster/MVP skill
  AI is a separate roadmap item. Include source boss species, distinguish basic
  prototype combat from authentic special mechanics. Audit population counts,
  spawn capacity, monster traits/element/status tables and actual sprite IDs.
- Preserve one-map residency; budget terrain/scenery atlases, geometry and
  monster frames for64MiB shared RAM. Evict stale enemy caches on travel; don't
  let exploring more maps accumulate all decoded sprite families.32 visible
  actors can remain a render budget; don't silently drop source populations.
- Append new compressed map resources to original world.bin when practical.
  Preserve old seven map blobs verbatim. Updater must reuse baseline world
  PREFIX plus actor data; old package helper assumes whole world.bin unchanged
  and must be adapted. New source build must stage matching new resources from
  updated ISO or reproducible received collections; avoid duplicating whole
  worlds/source payload unnecessarily. User receives complete source and exact
  incremental update against42, GitHub, no rollback bundle.
- Expand all WORLD_MAP_COUNT users, pending gates, test travel, portal/memo/save
  map bounds and minimaps. Don't simply change array counts without data.

Base level99 / progression
- Obtain full pre-re FirstClasses Base EXP group (98 transitions), confirm HP/SP
  arrays through index98 for all seven current jobs, safe stat/EXP/HP arithmetic.
- Audit literal20 caps in level controls, class presets, stat refresh, source
  arrays, save validation, level-up hints and skill formulas. Keep Novice job10
  and first-job job50 separate from base99. User did not request second jobs yet.
- Current prototype: stat_budget=12+4*(level-1), stat cap30, custom maxHP baseline
  plus job table deltas. Decide explicitly which progression formulas are source
  backed vs prototype; don't claim full authentic RO balance by changing cap.
  Review stat limits/budget consistency alongside99. No rushed invented growth.
- Old disposable test saves need no migration. If preset/curve schema changes,
  use fresh namespace and retain previous files. Preserve popup preferences in
  new schema; user's workflow accepts fresh characters.
- Verify reaching99 naturally/testtool, no table OOB, correct cap EXP discard,
  save/load at low20/mid/high99 and first-job tier separation.

Next playtest/release checklist
Connected route traversal both directions; Payon/Archer Village/five dungeon
floors; source populations and representative new enemy families; zoning/cache
RAM behavior across repeated outdoor/town/dungeon transitions; level99 growth,
new circle slider/shape/ticks; live Select vs paused START. Native build and
host checks first. No emulator/hardware/FPS/RAM claims without actual testing.

Updated roadmap
Requested Payon expedition + first-job stabilization/base99 -> remaining first-job
mechanics/effects/useful services -> second jobs -> broader equipment/loot/
consumables -> cards/refinement/crafting -> remaining maps/enemies/MVP behavior
-> offline progression/balance/real-hardware polish. AI companions last; no WoE.

COLLECTOR ROUTE HOTFIX
User's auto-discovery succeeded at D:\MyRO\MyROAllFiles\World\Server\hercules_pre
but old collector aborted on missing pay_arche route. Corrected shared npc/warps
scan alongside pre-re warps; shared npc/mobs also included for selected spawn
lines. UTF8-strict/BOM and CP949 fallback for server text; Korean paths and client
resnametable aliases tested. Missing route now marks partial and collects named
destination assets independently, with scoped warp evidence/file inventory.
No guessed warp coordinates or translated internal map identifiers. Fresh
RouteFix asset-request ZIP supersedes AutoFind ZIP, auto-discovery retained.

MYRO TEST40 EFFECT / ARTWORK CHECKLIST

Fast route: HOLD START about0.6s > Testing > Developer testing tools >
Skill checks (LB/RB pages) > Art preview. Left/right selects one of18 named
entries; A resumes play and previews near the player for8 gameplay seconds.
Energy Coat is a one-shot pulse in preview. Others loop for inspection.
Previews are visual only: no damage, resources, status or gameplay fields.

For real skills, use Class presets to learn the implemented skills, restore
HP/SP, and spawn a passive practice target with x100HP. Keep target type Natural.
Impacts play on completion; bolt air phases begin in the last0.4s of casting.
Wait for the blue cast bar. A failed/blocked skill
may keep resources or display an action response rather than create a field.

01 [ ] Energy Coat cast - Mage Energy Coat. ONE cast pulse, followed by a steady
       subtle blue player tint while the buff is active. Check expiry/tint reset.
       The steady tint is a prototype status cue, not original aura playback.
02 [ ] Cure - Acolyte Cure. Apply Blind in Skill checks first; Cure removes it
       and plays the rising source effect. No ailment means no cast/resources.
03 [ ] Freeze - Frost Diver impact and frozen living targets. Cold Bolt also
       reuses this art for impact; its art does NOT grant the freeze mechanic.
04 [ ] Holy hit - Acolyte Holy Light on a valid living practice target.
05 [ ] Fire Wall - Mage Fire Wall on clear ground. Inspect all live cells,
       turn/zoom camera, lure a target through it, then check cell expiry.
06 [ ] Fire hit - Fire Bolt impact, Fire Ball and Magnum Break art reuse.
       Fire Bolt now has a separate airborne phase (entry16 below).
07 [ ] Wind hit - Lightning Bolt impact. Airborne phase is entry18.
08 [ ] Thunder Storm - Mage ground field. Check overhead lightning and ground
       strikes across its duration. Existing half-second mechanics are unchanged.
09 [ ] Stone Curse - Cast/target and forming-stone phase. Check the result
       message; immunity/resistance is a mechanic, not proof of missing artwork.
10 [ ] Cart Revolution - Merchant, rented cart, melee loadout and living target.
       Look for the original burst; existing cost/damage/knockback stay unchanged.
11 [ ] Cart style1 - Fast preview OR free Cart Stylist service in Prontera.
12 [ ] Cart style2 - Same. These preview styles match the original collected art.
13 [ ] Cart style3 - Same.
14 [ ] Cart style4 - Same.
15 [ ] Cart style5 - Same.
16 [ ] Air: Fire Bolt - NEW falling fire-texture volley over the target, followed
       by impact. Volley count follows learned rank, capped at10 visually.
17 [ ] Air: Cold Bolt - NEW falling blue ice volley before its impact clip.
18 [ ] Air: Lightning Bolt - NEW descending blue/white streaks over the target.

Entries01-10 sample the supplied original STR timelines at15Hz. Entries16-18
are prototype airborne paths composed from received original textures, not
imports of the original client's complete bolt model/effect system. Hit/resource
logic and numerical timing are unchanged; visual travel/impact timing is a
prototype approximation. There is a shared24-instance visual cap.

CART TEST ROUTE
Use Merchant class preset; rent a cart from the existing supplies merchant.
The third visible NPC near the Prontera starting area is now the Cart Stylist,
48worldunits from the centre along the other street axis, between/beyond the two
existing service NPCs. Three gold minimap service markers are shown.
Approach the third NPC and press A. Choose any of five styles for free and B to
leave. This test service bypasses level/SP restrictions; the normal Change Cart
skill keeps its existing level requirements (41/66/81/91 for higher styles).
Check stillness, movement, stop/start, all camera angles/zooms and all styles.
Idle must not bounce. Wheels should stay at the projected ground contact, with
a24-unit gap behind the player. Cart depth is sorted with characters.

OTHER TESTS
- Toggle Tooltips OFF, press Select, navigate windows and sit/stand: no optional
  control/sitting/hover tips. Action responses/errors still use the bottom dock.
- Toggle Tooltips ON: all transient captions share ONE bottom area, including
  when a window is retained open. Long captions page every2s rather than stack.
- All eight yellow target-corner strokes: complete, bottom sides rise, about
  one-third thinner. HP bar is unchanged. Check different enemies/camera/zoom.
- No LVL UP square: holding LB/RB must not open Stats/Skills; quick actions still
  fire on release. With a visible level-up square, its hold shortcut should work.
- Tap START: normal Game menu. Hold START0.6s: Testing page directly. The world
  pauses immediately; the Game page is not flashed first while holding.
- Skill checks > ranged-hit test: A resumes play and arms a20raw physical hit
  after ONE gameplay second. Pausing/menus suspend the countdown. Coat/Pneuma/
  existing protection still apply. Map travel or knockout cancels the test.

Please report effect size/position, missing layers, brightness, timing, cart
occlusion, FPS/free RAM and any issue by entry number. Host/native checks do not
replace your xemu testing; no emulator/hardware results are claimed for Test40.

MYRO TEST41 - EFFECTS AND CONTROLS TO TEST

QUICK ROUTES
Hold START about0.6s > Testing > Developer testing tools.
LB/RB changes developer page. Class presets learn the implemented first-job
skills. Player > Cart distance: LEFT/RIGHT adjusts0..32 world units, A resets12.
Tell me the number that looks right. It is temporary, session-only tuning.
Player > Walking pace: default84%, LEFT/RIGHT adjusts; A resets84%. Retained.
Practice > Spawn target, then > Behaviour: A or LEFT/RIGHT toggles Idle/Active.
Active targets chase and attack, even while Other monster AI is paused. Immortal
practice remains optional. No rewards or automatic respawn. Spawn again if dead.
Use a durable practice target to test Fire Wall; natural passive monsters can
also be toggled active for this test without changing normal monster species.

START > Game > Toggles and pop-ups... (or LB/RB to the Toggles tab):
Damage OFF by default. EXP/level-up, Loot, Skills/status, Items/services, System
and overhead Spell name callouts each have separate switches. These switches
control text notifications; floating damage numbers always remain visible.
Pop-up switches and Tooltips are saved with the character in fresh Save22 slots.
Help/diagnostics, Scenery, Music and Sound switches are also accessible here;
they retain their existing session behavior. Audio volume remains in Audio.
Tooltips OFF hides optional control/hover/sitting tips, independently of spell
callouts. System OFF can hide ordinary action/error messages; save-failure
warnings remain visible. No extra pop-up is needed to confirm your damage.
EXP and loot remain independently switchable even on the same enemy defeat.

ART PREVIEW ROUTE
Developer > Skill checks > Art preview. LEFT/RIGHT chooses one of21 named
entries; A resumes play for an8-second visual preview. Preview does not apply
mechanics. Frozen-target hold must be tested with actual Frost Diver, not its
looping artwork preview. Numbered entries match the menu order below.

01 [ ] Energy Coat cast - unchanged accepted one-shot pulse and steady tint.
02 [ ] Cure - Acolyte Cure after applying a removable ailment.
03 [ ] Freeze - Mage Frost Diver on a living target. Ice forms, then HOLDS its
       formed frame while frozen. Cold Bolt reuses impact art without freezing.
04 [ ] Holy hit - Acolyte Holy Light on a valid target.
05 [ ] Fire Wall - cast between yourself and an ACTIVE durable practice target.
       Check three cells, movement/contact/knockback and expiry. Idle is also
       available. Existing hit/collision/resource mechanics are unchanged.
06 [ ] Fire hit - Fire Bolt, Fire Ball impact, Magnum Break reuse.
07 [ ] Wind hit - Lightning Bolt impact, unchanged.
08 [ ] Thunder Storm small bolts - Mage Thunder Storm. Smaller staggered bolts
       spread around the field replace the oversized composite artwork. Strike
       timing/damage and square gameplay bounds remain unchanged. While aiming,
       the indicator is a circular ring of small tapered shimmering blue points,
       red if invalid. Circular artwork does not imply circular damage checks.
09 [ ] Stone Curse - unchanged accepted forming-stone loop and petrification.
10 [ ] Cart Revolution - original burst plus NEW tight visual player spin.
       Check in place from several angles; damage/knockback/facing unaffected.
11 [ ] Cart style1 - Merchant with rented cart; free Prontera Cart Stylist.
12 [ ] Cart style2 - same. All five style options remain available there.
13 [ ] Cart style3 - same.
14 [ ] Cart style4 - same.
15 [ ] Cart style5 - same. Check idle stillness, walking and slider distances.
16 [ ] Air: Fire Bolt - accepted airborne phase and impact, unchanged.
17 [ ] Air: Cold Bolt - accepted airborne phase and impact, unchanged.
18 [ ] Air: Lightning Bolt - accepted airborne phase and impact, unchanged.
19 [ ] Fire Ball flight - NEW compact orange projectile from caster to target
       in the last0.35s of a normal cast, followed by accepted impact. Very short
       or skipped observed casts use a post-release visual fallback. Projectile
       is visual only and does not introduce extra damage/delay/collision.
20 [ ] Casting aura - NEW warm yellow animated rim/wisps around caster during
       timed casting. Stops on completion or interruption. Check different zooms.
21 [ ] Spell target circle - NEW ground circle/star: shrinks, rotates, flashes
       white/red for0.6s after successful casts. Implemented for Fire/Cold/
       Lightning Bolt, Napalm Beat, Soul Strike, Fire Ball, Frost Diver, Thunder
       Storm, Decrease AGI, Stone Curse and Holy Light. Preview near the player.

ADDITIONAL VISUAL/CONTROL CHECKS
[ ] Small translucent black spell-name callout above caster, independent of
    Tooltips; its own Toggles switch hides it. No central notification stack.
[ ] Blue cast bar: equal-width segments with single-pixel black separators.
    Half-second intervals, maximum12 segments; unused edge pixels are margins.
    Fractional final intervals are approximate. No separator at the endpoints.
[ ] Yellow target corners have3px clearance from the current monster crop;
    grow immediately as needed and relax smoothly as its animation shrinks.
[ ] Inventory Zeny/Weight summary uses full normal-size font instead of0.7x.
    Large balances abbreviate to K/M only when necessary. Inspect on a CRT.
[ ] R3 closes the focused window then focuses the most recently opened remaining
    window; repeated R3 closes the rest. Close-button wrap behavior is retained.
[ ] Toggle each pop-up type independently. Attack, cast, defeat and loot a
    natural enemy; confirm numbers/resources/EXP still change with text hidden.
[ ] Preserve accepted hotbars, camera/zoom, short/long START and level-up hints.

AUTHENTICITY / LIMITS
Entries01-10 originally sample supplied STR artwork at15Hz; Thunder Storm now
uses the smaller prototype bolt path. Entries16-20 are prototype compositions
from collected textures. Entry21 and the aiming ring are procedural prototypes,
not the original client's full effects/models. Exact original effect playback
remains unfinished. Existing numerical mechanics have not been replaced by
visual approximations. Shared24-instance art pool remains capped; crowd effects
can be omitted when saturated. All assets needed for this batch were available.
No xemu, original-Xbox, runtime FPS/free-RAM or Windows picker testing claimed.
Please report by entry number, plus observed FPS/free RAM and cart distance.

MYRO TEST41 - FEEDBACK FIXES, SPELL VISUALS AND NOTIFICATION TOGGLES

Extract the entire ZIP. Run Apply-Update.cmd and select your exact working
Test40 MyRO-Current.iso. The updater verifies it, builds/verifies the Test41
MyRO-Current.iso and retains the original input safely. Load the resulting ISO
in xemu and reset. Do not select a ZIP or the xemu hard-drive image.
